name: devin-memory
description: Registers the devin-memory MCP server (devin-brain: anti-poisoning memory for agents) with VS Code's MCP support. Thin adapter: the extension only declares how to launch the server — no tool logic is reimplemented here.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Launches the user-installed devin-memory MCP server. In Restricted Mode the workspace-configured executable, args and dbPath are ignored; the server resolves from PATH with built-in defaults.

devinMemory.executable.description: devin-memory MCP server executable (name or absolute path; e.g. 'uvx' with args ['devin-memory-mcp'])

devinMemory.args.description: Arguments passed to the MCP server executable

devinMemory.dbPath.description: DEVIN_MEMORY_DB — path to memory.db (empty = server default: ./memory.db under the workspace folder)
